screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows two dielectric media meeting at a horizontal interface, with electric field E and displacement D vectors in each medium.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls set relative permittivity for each medium, free surface charge σ_f, E₁ magnitude, and toggles for components, field lines, protractor, angles, and bound charge. Reset All restores the starting state.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Drag the tip of E₁ to change its angle from the surface normal, then adjust εᵣ or σ_f and watch which components stay continuous. Turn on bound charge to see polarization P and σ_b that explain why Eₙ jumps.

electric.currentDetails: Electric boundary conditions at a planar interface.

controls.surfaceCharge: Free surface charge density σ_f on the interface

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows two magnetic media meeting at a horizontal interface, with H and B vectors in each medium.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls set relative permeability for each medium, free surface current K_f, H₁ magnitude, and toggles for components, field lines, protractor, and angles. Reset All restores the starting state.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Drag the tip of H₁ to change its angle from the surface normal, then adjust μᵣ or K_f and watch which components stay continuous.

magnetic.currentDetails: Magnetic boundary conditions at a planar interface.

controls.surfaceCurrent: Free surface current density K_f on the interface
